name: Prisjakt Tracker
description: Track Prisjakt and PriceSpy products from Orca's sidebar: search or paste a link, see every item's price history at a glance, set target prices and get notified when they drop. Not affiliated with Prisjakt.

cover.alt: Prisjakt Tracker in Orca's sidebar: tracked products with prices and sparklines, beside one product's price chart, target and shops

settings.title: Market
settings.description: Which Prisjakt / PriceSpy site search uses. Pasted links keep their own site.

settings.title: Refresh every (hours)
settings.description: How often prices are checked in the background while Orca runs.

settings.title: Notify at target price
settings.description: A desktop notification when an item reaches the target price you set on it.

settings.title: Notify on new all-time low
settings.description: A desktop notification when an item is cheaper than it has ever been.

settings.title: Notify on every price drop
settings.description: A desktop notification whenever any tracked item gets cheaper.

settings.title: Ignore drops smaller than (%)
settings.description: Price drops below this percentage are not highlighted or notified.
